findings.title: Debounced slow typing repeatedly erases the first character
findings.reproduction: At 412x900, focus input, Ctrl+A, type Sherlock with 260 ms between keys, then wait 350 ms. The 210 ms debounce fires between each key. Input ends empty, focused, caret 0. Fast Dune succeeds.
findings.causeEvidence: Line 328 selects empty state for query length <=1; line 147 renders an empty input in empty state, discarding the first character.
findings.source: reference/desktop/qml/BiblioSearch.qml:53,237-244; SearchSurface.qml:27,62 (input text remains authority; empty means zero characters)
findings.requiredCorrection: Preserve query text independently of empty/suggestion/result presentation; recheck slow typing, pauses after the first character, replacement, caret and complete queries in every lane.

findings.title: Submitting a populated query loses input focus
findings.reproduction: Fast-type Sherlock, wait for populated results with input focused, press Enter, then type space Holmes.
findings.observed: Before Enter: value Sherlock, active true. After Enter: active BODY, field value Sherlock. Further keyboard typing does not update query.
findings.causeEvidence: Enter handler calls render without restoring field focus/caret, unlike the debounce handler at line 328.
findings.requiredCorrection: Preserve submission focus/caret and confirm continued typing/editing works after Enter.
